column2: aptus Philippines brief target 3 — Philippine chart of accounts
SAP Best Practices 2608 account master data for the YCOA template chart of accounts

NO HARVEST WAS NEEDED, AND THERE IS NO SEPARATE PHILIPPINE CHART. This workbook is the country-independent one already in the repository. It carries one column per country company code — "PH (5810)" is the Philippines — marking which YCOA accounts that country uses. It also carries 20 "Alternative Account Number" columns for countries that have their own local chart (AT, BE, BR, CH, CN, CZ, DE, ES, FI, FR, HU, JP, LU, NO, PT, RO, RU, SE, TR, TW). THERE IS NO PH ALTERNATIVE-ACCOUNT COLUMN: SAP publishes the Philippines as using the YCOA template chart directly, with no local chart variant. Malaysia has none either.
complete for this source. 865 accounts on the sheet; 578 are marked for the Philippine company code and are the rows of this file.

the brief asks for this explicitly: Malaysia is marked on 570 accounts of the same sheet, the Philippines on 578. The brief warns that a PH count landing on exactly Malaysia's 871 would suggest an accidental re-read of the MY file — it does not. Note also that aptus's 871 SapGlAccount rows did NOT come from this sheet (865 accounts); they came from BP_CLD_ENTPR_2608_Account_Master_Data_for_YCOA_MY.xlsx, sheet "YCOA_local", which is company-code-level MY data. The Philippine equivalent of THAT file (a "..._PH.xlsx" local workbook) is not in the repository and is not published anonymously — see the notes file.
